subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in columns A, B and C to write complete
stimulus: sentences. 1×5= 5 Column A Column B Column C (a) Some people want (i) forgetting their roots (1) their roots to (b) Many people live (ii) have not forgotten (2) the Mainul brothers are in cities living in the village, (c) Mainul Islam and (iii) stick to their roots (3) knowingly or his brothers unknowingly (d) Despite being (iv) highly educated (4) advanced farming (e) After the (v) Mainul came to his village (5) in any situation completion of his and started graduation
guide_solution: Match Column A, Column B and Column C: (a) Some people want to stick to their roots in any situation. (b) Many people live in cities forgetting their roots knowingly or unknowingly. (c) Mainul Islam and his brothers have not forgotten their roots. (d) Despite being highly educated the Mainul brothers are living in the village. (e) After completion of his graduation Mainul came to his village and started advanced farming.
